title: Sign in to Music World
intro: Enter your e-mail address: we send you a sign-in link (no password).
sent: Check {email}: the link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
missingToken: This sign-in link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: The e-mail could not be sent. Try again later.
errors.AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired.
errors.NETWORK: The server could not be reached. Try again.
